answer: The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in grove, expire in saffron, and garden lists each expiry. Someone running 129 aliases as a result needs 35 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4216 identities would post 4160 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
